verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a consumer AI assistant like Poke, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting to opt out of telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The X-Poke-User-Id header and the usage/credit docs concern identification and billing, not tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
